notes: Weather effects for the DM app. D&D 2024. Wind adds to the long rest DC: Calm 0, Breeze +2, Gust +5, Storm +10. Lookup: state (with season override) + wind. Travel and restDC are always shown; effect lines are optional reminders.

travel.display: Show percent and Normal pace miles/day, e.g. '75% (18 mi/day)'

clearSight.text: Good visibility: Advantage on Perception to spot things far away

hearingDisadv.text: Noise: Disadvantage on Perception relying on hearing

fogObscured.text: Lightly Obscured within 30 ft, Heavily Obscured beyond

flamesOut.text: Unprotected flames go out; fire can't ignite objects

rainFireResist.text: Targets in the open have Resistance to Fire damage

coldSaves.text: Disadvantage on saves against Cold damage

hotFireSaves.text: Disadvantage on saves against Fire damage

concentrationDisadv.text: Disadvantage on saves to keep Concentration

cloudDrift.text: Cloud spells drift 10 ft downwind each round

cloudDisperse.text: Cloud spells disperse at the end of the caster's next turn

muddyGround.text: Unpaved ground outdoors is Difficult Terrain

deepSnow.text: Snow-covered ground outdoors is Difficult Terrain

icyGround.text: Dashing on ice: DC 10 Dex (Acrobatics) or fall Prone

flyMustLand.text: Flyers without Hover must end their turn on the ground or fall

breezeHeat.text: In Hot weather: Advantage on the heat exposure save

rules.combine: Season override replaces fields of the base state. Travel = state.travel + wind.travelMod, min 25. Rest DC = state.restDC + wind.restDCMod. Effect list = state effects + wind effects, no duplicates.
longRest: One character rolls Wisdom (Survival) when making camp. Others can Help (Advantage).
Tent or tarp: -5 DC. Cave, building or Tiny Hut: no roll.
Fail: rest counts, but no Exhaustion removed and only half Hit Dice regained.
Fail by 5+: counts only as a Short Rest.
exposure: End of each travel day: every creature makes a Constitution save vs the exposure DC. Fail: 1 Exhaustion.
Proper gear (cold-weather clothing, or plenty of water and shade) gives Advantage.
Resistance to Cold or Fire (matching type): automatic success.
